object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Read an object file whose table has two col elements and a row with one cell. Then check the tiling of tables: a 2x2 rectangle; one cell spanning 3 columns of 3; a cell spanning 2 rows beside a normal cell, with one cell in the next row; a 2x2 block plus a third column; a cell spanning 3 columns of 2; a row with one cell of 3 columns; a row with 3 cells of 2 columns; a cell spanning 3 rows of 1; rows with no col element; a second row holding two cells where the first row's cell spans 2 rows; a table with no columns and no rows. Expected: the file is a load error for its geometry. The rectangle, the full-width span, the row span with one cell in the next row, the block and the empty table tile; each other table is reported, and the second-row case only with two cells.
